correctness.rationale: For all m>=2, K_m counts ones by the exact substitution recurrence K_{m+1}=2^m-K_m. The disjoint image-01 blocks embed (01)^K and guarantee all binary length-K subsequences. Every binary length-(K+1) word with factor 01 embeds by one shared block. Remaining candidates are 1^r0^(K+1-r); the earliest-r-ones criterion and exact terminal 00 versus 1000101 prove the 1/3 dichotomy. Zero count covers r=0. Independent next-position automaton counting for m=2..13 and direct exhaustive enumeration through m=5 replay from verify.py: VERIFY_OK. Finite tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: An exact natural infinite-family classification, not an arbitrary finite sample: every shortest missing scattered word of each dyadic period-doubling prefix is specified, lengths grow exponentially yet class cardinality alternates 1 and 3. This separates the small structured morphic family from the large general SAS possibilities and identifies a sharp terminal-gap mechanism, relevant to sparse sequence universality/reconstruction benchmarks. No downstream theorem or larger contribution is asserted.
